description: liionpack is a Python tool for simulating many battery cells connected in a pack using PyBaMM cell models. Users define a pack circuit, cell parameters and operating profile, and the software solves electrical and thermal behaviour across the cells. The configured pack and duty cycle determine scale and time span; the package contains no fixed vehicle or grid battery deployment. Public source, examples and documentation are MIT licensed. The output can help compare storage sizing, cell imbalance and degradation assumptions for electric vehicles or stationary grid batteries. A caveat is that pack results depend on the chosen cell chemistry, parameter calibration and heat-transfer assumptions, and the JOSS paper does not establish performance for every commercial battery. PyBaMM is a separate modelling dependency. No directly related catalogue or first-review record matched this pack tool. The JOSS summary, own repository and README were checked, but no pack simulation or battery dataset was run.
